ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: New York City
Commitment: 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for an engineer who wants to work close to customers and build the software that makes a deployment succeed.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Endex, you'll develop integrations and customer-specific capabilities where production engineering is required. You'll work with deployment teams and core engineering to turn useful field solutions into reusable product patterns.


YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Ship Customer Integrations: Build production code that connects Endex to customer systems and executes a real workflow end to end.

 - Work Within Enterprise Constraints: Design for authentication, permissions, data boundaries and the customer's operating environment.

 - Own the Production Outcome: Test integrations, add observability and recovery behavior, and support what you deploy through launch.

 - Coordinate Product Boundaries: Agree what belongs in a customer solution and what should enter the core product.

 - Make Work Reusable: Bring proven integration patterns and field learning back to engineering.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Software Engineering Foundation: You've shipped and maintained production software.

 - Integration Fluency: You can work with APIs, authentication and enterprise systems.

 - Customer Judgment: You ask good questions and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

 - Practical Builder: You choose a solution that works within real constraints.

 - Customer-Facing Engineering: You can investigate requirements with users, make sound implementation trade-offs and maintain the code after it ships.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Python or TypeScript experience

 - Experience with AI applications or agent workflows

 - Experience with Python or Node.js, HTTP APIs and enterprise identity or Office integrations
